headline: UCCS beat Hawaii Hilo and stay unbeaten
dek: UCCS beat Hawaii Hilo on Wednesday for a fourth win, with a draw against Midwestern State the only match they have not won, and they have conceded three goals all season. Hawaii Hilo go on to CSU Pueblo and then MSU Denver, and CSU Pueblo have yet to lose.
displaced_by: UCCS beat Hawaii Hilo; the standing dek's fourteen goals is out of date, and the unbeaten run is now the story rather than the scoring gap

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The gap between the top and the bottom of the chart is still wide: Colorado Mesa, Colorado School of Mines, Regis and Adams State have scored fewer goals together than UCCS have alone.

wire.line: Adams State have lost all three of their matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but nine have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Sjöberg's nineteen saves for UCCS have come at the cost of three goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fort Lewis have three wins and a draw and have not lost, and play at Northwest Nazarene today.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Regis's draw at Cal State San Bernardino leaves them with one goal scored and one conceded across a win, a draw and a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado Mesa have drawn three matches and lost one, and are still without a win.

last_match.line: UCCS remain unbeaten and have scored in every match; Hawaii Hilo go on to CSU Pueblo and MSU Denver.

next_match.line: Fort Lewis are unbeaten and have scored in every match; Northwest Nazarene have already drawn at Westminster and at MSU Denver.
